SDK-C1CAC73D33C2BD90.rationale: Serializable diagnostic output remains in reports and typed tripwire causes; a nil callback result yields null. Diagnostic strings do not rewrite tool content.

SDK-1E00129C0812E950.rationale: Tripwire results terminate sequential evaluation and preserve typed diagnostic reports. Tool-output tripwires take precedence over replacement; input tripwires prevent provider dispatch.

SDK-7265E17F3E2FE578.rationale: Explicit successful replacement rewrites only tool content, including to the empty string; the next guard and subsequent model input see the replacement. Other output flags survive. This is not a claim for automatic function-span production.

SDK-3B14BC5EA25B2ABD.rationale: Rust Option<String> combines the replacement discriminator and payload: None does not replace; Some, including an empty string, explicitly replaces. Diagnostic Output alone does not replace, and a tripwire suppresses replacement. No redundant Go boolean is required.

SDK-E7536E28DBF7A586.rationale: A top-level input tripwire returns a typed input-phase cause, retains its report and diagnostic output, leaves final output unset, and never dispatches the provider.

SDK-4FE13C59011B0798.rationale: A tool-input tripwire prevents tool invocation, retains a named triggered report, supplies a model-visible error tool result on the second request, and lets the model produce its final answer.
